sentences.text:
Order 
Custody report of the appellant has been received from Superintendent of Central Jail, Sagar dated 01-11-2025

reflects that appellant - Subham s/o- Ramnarayan Khatik has served the entire jail sentence as awarded by the trial Court in Special Case No. 250/2015 U/ss.366-A, 376(2)(n),
376(2)(i) of IPC and under Sections 3/4 and 5(J)
(ii) of POCSO Act, 2012 .
As per the report the appellant has been released on 23-09-2025 from the Central Jail, Sagar after completion of his jail sentence as awarded the learned trial Court.
Since the sole appellant has already been released from jail after completing the jail sentence, this appeal is rendered infructuous.
It is accordingly disposed off having rendered infructuous.
Let copy of this order be order along with record of the trial court be sent to the concerned trial court for information and necessary compliance.
(B. P. SHARMA) JUDGE PG Shubham Khateek vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114903643/
